findings.evidence: Validate one raw Host header against strict DNS-label grammar and exact configured hostname without a port; cloud HTTP tests send actual Host using node:http and reject path, userinfo, fragment, internal whitespace, and port variants while retaining exact Origin.
Generator now sets app_password owner 70:70 mode 0400; deployment docs provide metadata-only chown/chmod for existing file and explicitly prohibit rerunning generator.
Cloud page names Cloud control plane, states queue-only/live execution disabled, and action is Unlock submissions.
